mapper.select:
SELECT c_room.room_id, c_room.room_type,
CASE WHEN c_room.room_type = 'ONE' THEN other_sawon.saname ELSE c_room.room_name END AS room_name,
c_room.created_at, c_member.joined_at, lm.sent_at, lm.content AS last_message, DATE_FORMAT(lm.sent_at, '%H:%i') AS last_message_time FROM chat_room c_room
JOIN chat_member c_member ON c_room.room_id = c_member.room_id
LEFT JOIN chat_member other_member ON c_room.room_id = other_member.room_id AND other_member.sabun != #{sabun}
LEFT JOIN sawon other_sawon ON other_member.sabun = other_sawon.sabun
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, content, sent_at FROM chat_message WHERE (room_id, message_id) IN ( SELECT room_id, MAX(message_id) FROM chat_message GROUP BY room_id ) ) lm ON c_room.room_id = lm.room_id
WHERE c_member.sabun = #{sabun} ORDER BY lm.sent_at DESC
mapper.insert: insert into chat_message(room_id, sender_sabun, saname, content, sent_at) values(#{room_id}, #{sender_sabun}, #{saname}, #{content}, now());
mapper.select: select sabun from chat_member where room_id = #{room_id}
select liked from chat_member where room_id=#{room_id} and sabun=#{sabun}
mapper.update: update chat_member set liked=#{liked} where room_id=#{room_id} and sabun=#{sabun}
mapper.select: select c_room.room_id, c_room.room_type, c_room.room_name, c_room.created_at, c_member.joined_at, lm.content as last_message, DATE_FORMAT(lm.sent_at, '%H:%i') as last_message_time, c_member.liked from chat_room as c_room join chat_member as c_member on c_room.room_id = c_member.room_id left join ( select room_id, content, sent_at from chat_message where (room_id, message_id) in ( select room_id, max(message_id) from chat_message group by room_id ) ) lm on c_room.room_id = lm.room_id where c_member.sabun = #{sabun} and c_member.liked = true order by lm.sent_at desc
